parent.reason: The R1 artificial background had Omega_m=Omega_r=0 and Omega_lambda=1. SWIFT tabulates cosmic age via an integral from a=0, for which the pure-de-Sitter time integrand is non-integrable at the lower endpoint.

purpose: Execute the same custom PartType6 transport-only SWIFT test after regularizing only the artificial background age integral with a tiny radiation component.
interpretation_boundary: Artificial engine-isolation cosmology only. PASS proves executable custom nonthermal neutrino-particle transport and no FD resampling. It does not validate the physical N_nu=1 background, self-gravity, halo response, or detectability.

artificial_transport_background.note: Only change from R1 is replacing the singular pure-de-Sitter background by a flat radiation+Lambda background. N_ur is omitted because SWIFT forbids specifying N_ur together with Omega_r.

inherited_particle_design: Exactly K01D1-R1: 1024 particles/state, 512 Mpc box, same IDs/positions/directions, antithetic direction pairs, stratified E8 quantiles, seed 2026110601.
inherited_custom_particle_kinematics: Exactly K01D1-R1: T_nu0=1.951757805 K, m_nu=0.06 eV used only to construct custom IC velocities; common inert macro mass=1 internal unit.

preregistered_acceptance.no_FD_resampling: If snapshot Weights exists it must be identically 1; if SampledSpeeds exists it must be identically 0.

stopping_and_next.if_fail: Do not proceed to self-gravity. Diagnose only SWIFT executable transport/background initialization.
